# Benchmark International Middle Market

> Benchmark International's Middle Market team represents privately held companies across the United States with $50M–$500M in total enterprise value (TEV) in sell-side M&A, recapitalizations and growth partnerships, across five industries: Industrial, Business Services, Consumer, Healthcare, Technology.

Information as of October 2026. Contact: 813-771-6675, mmt@benchmarkintl.com. Parent firm: Benchmark International (https://www.benchmarkintl.com/).

## Industries
- [Industrial](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/industrial.html): Manufacturing, industrial distribution, building products, energy and environmental services, and transportation.
- [Business Services](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/business-services.html): Commercial and facility services, marketing and tech-enabled services, engineering and consulting, financial and insurance services, and staffing and human capital.
- [Consumer](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/consumer.html): Food and beverage (including restaurants), consumer brands and products, foodservice and distribution, and consumer services.
- [Healthcare](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/healthcare.html): Provider services, life sciences and diagnostics, medical products and distribution, and pharmacy and healthcare services.
- [Technology](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/technology.html): Vertical software, enterprise and infrastructure software, IT and managed services, and communications and hardware.

- [Industrial Q4 2026 M&A Sector Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/industrial-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/industrial-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf)): Manufacturing and industrial technology; distribution and services; building products and construction services; energy, power and environmental services; and transportation and logistics: the order books, the deal market and what acquirers are paying for.
- [Business Services Q4 2026 M&A Sector Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/business-services-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/business-services-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf)): Commercial and facility services; marketing, sales and tech-enabled services; engineering, architecture and consulting; financial and insurance services; and staffing and human capital: the deal market, public-market valuations and what buyers are paying for.
- [Consumer Q4 2026 M&A Sector Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/consumer-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/consumer-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf)): Food and beverage (including restaurants), consumer brands and products, foodservice and distribution, and consumer services and retail: who is buying, what they are paying for and what an owner can prepare.
- [Healthcare Q4 2026 M&A Sector Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/healthcare-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/healthcare-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf)): Provider services, life sciences and diagnostics, medical products and distribution, and pharmacy and healthcare services: the deal market, the policy calendar and what buyers are paying for.
- [Technology Q4 2026 M&A Sector Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/technology-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/technology-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf)): Managed IT and cloud services, cybersecurity, telecom and UCaaS, systems integration, electronics and hardware, and government technology: the deal market, the policy calendar and what buyers are paying for.

## Common questions
- **What does Benchmark International's Middle Market team do?** Benchmark International's Middle Market team represents privately held companies across the United States in sell-side M&A, recapitalizations and growth partnerships.
- **What size companies does the Middle Market team advise?** The team serves privately held companies with a total enterprise value (TEV) of $50 million to $500 million.
- **Which industries does the Middle Market team focus on?** Five industry groups: Industrial, Business Services, Consumer, Healthcare and Technology.
- **What services does the Middle Market team provide?** Services include sell-side M&A, recapitalizations and partial sales, strategic partnerships and growth capital, and exit planning and valuation.
- **How does working with Benchmark International start?** The first step is always a confidential conversation about your goals, your company and your options. A senior member of the Middle Market team sets up a private conversation, then walks you through the paths available, from a partial recapitalization to a full sale.
- **How large is Benchmark International?** Benchmark International is the #1 privately owned sell-side M&A advisor worldwide, based on PitchBook's Q2 2026 Global League Tables, with 15 offices across the Americas, Europe and Africa.
- **How do I contact the Middle Market team?** Call 813-771-6675 or email mmt@benchmarkintl.com.
